text: Wata on jooɗo e kala laawol, hiɗon kammbana feƴƴooɓe ngol, jaɓon jawle maɓɓe, sakkoɗon ɓe e laawol peewal, hiɗon ɗaɓɓana laawol Alla ngol kadi ooñaare fii wata yimɓe ɓen jokku ngol. Annditee neema Alla on e mo'on yetton Mo ; o laatinoke seeɗaaɓe O ɗuɗɗini on. Taskee honno battane bonnooɓe ɓen ado mon laatornoo, ɗum ko halkaare e jirbugol wonnoo.
